script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now, demanding your attention. Mars, your ruling planet, is forming a tense square to Venus in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating friction in relationships, and your fire element amplifies this intensity. At the same time, Jupiter is trining your 10th House of Professional Status, opening doors to advancement. The Moon in your 2nd House suggests a sudden influx of funds. If you're single, this energy attracts a passionate but intense connection; if you're in a relationship, watch for miscommunication. Your career outlook shines as Jupiter trines your 10th House, bringing unexpected opportunities for promotion. Financially, the Moon in your 2nd House suggests a sudden influx of funds, but avoid impulsive spending. A blessing arrives as Mercury sextiles your 3rd House of Communication, ensuring clear dialogue. Follow for tomorrow's reading today.
